# Equipment API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A device installed in a setup, such as an amplifier, a camera or a laser.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/equipment/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/equipment/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `equipment` (detail, create, update), `equipment` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `setup` (from [`setup`](/api/personal_attributes/setup/))
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [Equipment type](/api/schemas/equipment/); send its fields in `details`. `type_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Schema payload:** `coordinates_system` selects a [Coordinates type](/api/schemas/coordinates/); send its fields in `coordinates_details`. `coordinates_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters. Name of the equipment, e.g., "Ephys amplifier" or "Ceiling mounted camera". |
| `type` | one of the [Equipment types](/api/schemas/equipment/) **[required]** |
| `notes` | string; max 500 characters; nullable |
| `setup` | [`setup`](/api/personal_attributes/setup/) id **[required]**; nestable |
| `date_time` | datetime; nullable |
| `consumable` | [`consumable`](/api/resources/consumable/) id; nullable |
| `hardwaredevice` | [`hardwaredevice`](/api/resources/hardwaredevice/) id; nullable |
| `details` | JSON object |
| `coordinates_system` | one of the [Coordinates types](/api/schemas/coordinates/) **[required]** |
| `coordinates_details` | JSON object |
| `type_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]** |
| `coordinates_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/equipment/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('equipment', load_all=True)
records = resp['equipment']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('equipment', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.equipment;
```

{: .no_toc}

```json
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Equipment 1",
            "type": "Amplifier",
            "notes": "",
            "setup": "<setup-id>",
            "date_time": "2024-03-22T10:30:00Z",
            "consumable": "<consumable-id>",
            "hardwaredevice": "<hardwaredevice-id>",
            "details": {
                "...": "see the schema of the selected type"
            },
            "coordinates_system": "",
            "coordinates_details": {
                "...": "see the schema of the selected type"
            },
            "type_schema_version": "set by the server",
            "coordinates_schema_version": "set by the server",
            "user": "<user-id>"
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/equipment/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('equipment', data={"name": "Equipment 1", "type": "Amplifier", "setup": "<setup-id>", "details": {"...": "see the schema of the selected type"}, "coordinates_system": "External_XYZ_Euler", "coordinates_details": {"...": "the fields of the selected Coordinates type"}})
record = resp.json()['equipment']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Equipment 1', 'type', 'Amplifier', 'setup', '<setup-id>', 'details', struct(), 'coordinates_system', 'External_XYZ_Euler', 'coordinates_details', struct()), 'equipment');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.equipment;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/equipment/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('equipment', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['equipment']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
record = out.equipment;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/equipment/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('equipment', id='<id>', data={"name": "Equipment 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Equipment 1 (renamed)'), 'equipment', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/equipment/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('equipment', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'equipment');
```
